oneTimers: Stock-based compensation was $89.1M in the quarter — the main gap between GAAP net income ($168M) and non-GAAP net income ($240M, diluted basis).
A $12.0M impairment loss on a non-marketable investment, partly offset by a $6.5M mark-to-market gain on a marketable equity security — both inside other income, net.
Management raised the full-year FY26 net sales outlook to at least $36B in this release, up from at least $33B reiterated in the October business update.
otherDetail: Other income, net of $51.2M less $24.9M of interest expense — a net $26.3M gain outside operations. The $51.2M was mostly interest income, up $43.3M on larger cash deposits funded by convertible-note proceeds, plus a $6.5M mark-to-market gain and $4.4M of foreign-exchange gains, partly offset by a $12.0M impairment loss on a non-marketable investment. A separate $0.1M share of loss from an equity investee, net of taxes, is shown as equityM (amounts from thousands).

sources.label: Form 10-Q for the quarter ended Sep 30, 2025 (SEC EDGAR)

takeaways.text: Net sales fell to $5.0B from $5.9B a year ago because several large orders arrived only in late September and could not ship — customer configuration upgrades and data-center readiness delays pushed them into Q2. US sales fell 57% while Asia sales more than doubled.
takeaways.title: Sales slipped on timing, not demand

takeaways.text: Gross margin fell to 9.3% from 13.1% a year ago on product and customer mix, plus $42M of tariff costs and $27M more in inventory write-downs — so gross profit fell 40% even though sales fell only 15%.
takeaways.title: Margins thinned further

takeaways.text: Net income fell to $168M from $424M a year ago and $195M in Q4. Operations used $918M of cash as inventories rose $1.0B to build ahead of the delayed orders, while management pointed to more than $13B in Blackwell Ultra orders and raised full-year FY26 revenue guidance to at least $36B.
takeaways.title: Profit fell, but the order book grew

verdict: Supermicro's sales fell 15.5% to $5.0B as big AI orders landed too late in the quarter to ship, and with gross margin down to 9.3%, net income dropped 60% to $168M.
